## ✅ Acceptance Criteria (Definition of Done)

This task will be considered completed and ready for review only if all the following criteria are met.

✔️ The code implements the functionality described in the objective.  
✔️ The code passes all unit and integration tests.  
✔️ The functionality is documented in the agreed format.
